one_liner: Waterfall.io offers a REST contact/company enrichment API with x-api-key auth, but keys are issued only by approval after a sales-style review, and pricing is quoted by benchmark.
auth_notes: Static API key sent in x-api-key header; master key can create sub-keys. No OAuth documented.
access_notes: API access is by approval; request a key via work email or book a call. No self-serve signup or free tier; pricing quoted after a benchmark on your own records.
blocker_notes: Keys require team approval and a pricing conversation with the founders; no self-serve path.

evidence.quote: Authenticate data and account API requests with your Waterfall API key in the `x-api-key` header.
API access is available by approval. Enter your work email on the [Waterfall website](https://www.waterfall.io/) to request a key
Per-credit rates depend on the endpoints you use and the volume you commit to, and are quoted after a benchmark on a sample of your own records
The Waterfall API is available at `https://api.waterfall.io`. Send your API key in the `x-api-key` header.
A [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) (MCP) server that enables AI assistants like Claude to interact with [Databar.ai](https://databar.ai)'s data enrichment API.
